captions.linkedin:
ProdReady by Innovate shows how structured instructions, specialized tools, a controlled execution process and MCP connectivity can turn an existing coding agent into part of a much more disciplined development workflow.

I tested it on my own project, the Formulation Decision System (FDS), an AI-powered decision-support application for dietary supplement formulation that keeps critical decisions under human control.

In a few days, three assessment rounds raised the due diligence score for FDS from 2.9 to 3.4 out of 5, and 27 development stories became five sprints implemented in code. I stopped once my experiment's goals were met; the formal review steps were not completed, so this is not production certification.

The lesson: AI-assisted development doesn't need more complicated agents. It needs better-structured systems around increasingly capable models.

More: https://prodready.si/
